content.comment_body: Hello, I am using an [product_name] module with a PT100 sensor. Within [product_name] software, I connect the analog input to an amplifier and select PT100. The issue I'm facing is the temperature range is limited to -50 to 200°C, but I need to measure up to approximately 300°C. Is there a way to overcome this limitation?

Measuring up to 300°C is not possible with the [product_name] module, as its range is fixed from -50 to 200°C. You would need an external PT100 (or PT1000) sensor with a 0-10V or 0/4-20mA output. If you do not have a [product_name] base module with onboard analog inputs (0-10V), an additional [product_name] module with 0-10V or 0/4-20mA analog inputs will be required.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a limitation due to the restricted temperature measurement range of the [product_name] module, which only supports -50 to 200°C. This reflects a common usability issue where hardware constraints prevent users from meeting application needs, such as measuring up to 300°C, which is often required for industrial tasks. The fixed input ranges in modules from [company_name] can present obstacles for users with broader measurement requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the [product_name] module to allow temperature measurements up to 300°C, aligning with the PT100 sensor's capability and the standards typically needed in industrial environments.
